column1: # Single-inheritance bases, declared -- the pairer does NOT infer a class hierarchy.
# "base derived..." folds each derived class's evidence into the base, which is valid only
# where the base subobject sits at offset 0 of the derived one. CNWCItem is NOT listed: it is
# multiply inherited and its CNWCObject base sits at +0x48 (Linux) with no Windows twin.
